derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G4192 (πόνος);
def: to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried

occurrences.text: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
